data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterwernigerode (Betreuungsgericht) invites Uwe Beispielharz, as the son of Gertrud Beispielharz, to a hearing (Anhörung) on 21 January 2027 at 1:30 pm at the Pflegeheim „Am Brockenblick“, Zimmer 12, in connection with proceedings to appoint a legal guardian (Betreuer) for his mother. Attending is voluntary; a written statement can be sent instead.
data.explanation: This letter is from the local court handling guardianship (Betreuungsgericht) cases. A judge is deciding whether your mother needs a legal guardian and wants to hear your view as her son. You are invited to a hearing on 21 January 2027 at 1:30 pm at the care home named in the letter, but going in person is optional, not required by law. If you cannot or do not want to attend, you may instead send the court a written statement describing your view. No deadline or penalty is stated for either option.
